messages.subject: Legend for geom_abline objects
parts:
Hello,

I have a plot of growth curves, and have three lines of best fit on
top of these. Here is the code:

qplot(jitter=TRUE, x=Time, y=MaxXY, data=image4e, geom=c("line"),
colour=bh2, linetype=bh2, group=interaction(PID, LesionNum,bh2)) +
scale_colour_manual(values = c(gray,red,green)) +
scale_linetype_manual(values = c(1,16,17)) +
geom_abline(intercept=2.1,slope=0.01,colour = black, size =
2,linetype=1) +
geom_abline(intercept=2.7,slope = 0.01,colour = red, size =
2,linetype=16) +
geom_abline(intercept=1.9,slope=0.01,colour = green, size =
2,linetype=17)

Right now, this produces a legend for the three bh2 categories
(perfect), but I would also like to have a separate legend for the
three geom_ablines. The three geom_ablines do not correspond exactly
to the bh2 categories, so I would like to deal with the lines of best
fit separately from the rawdata. I think that I should make a
separate dataframe with the intercepts and slopes for the ablines, but
I'm not sure how I would proceed from there.

Thank you for your help,

Kim

messages.subject: Re: Legend for geom_abline objects
parts:
Hi Kim,

One easy approach is to

geom_abline(aes(colour = "BH1"), intercept=2.1,slope=0.01, size = 2,linetype=1)
